gloss: after a bath; fresh out of the bath

definitions.gloss: after a bath; fresh out of the bath
definitions.explanation: The state or moment immediately after getting out of the bath. Used to describe both the time period and the refreshed physical state that follows bathing.

examples.japanese: {風呂上|ふろあ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧だ。
examples.english: A beer after a bath is the best.

examples.japanese: {風呂上|ふろあ}がり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保湿|ほしつ}→保湿：11617_hoshitsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I moisturize after bathing so my skin doesn't dry out.

examples.japanese: {風呂上|ふろあ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦パジャマ→パジャマ：04516_pajama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}えて→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}っている→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧。
examples.english: The children, fresh out of the bath, are running around in their pajamas.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{風呂|ふろ}→風呂：14633_furo⟧ (bath) + ⟦{上|あ}がり→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (coming out of, finishing). Describes the period or state immediately after taking a bath. Bathing culture is central to Japanese daily life, and this word captures a familiar, pleasant moment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風呂上|ふろあ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧: a beer after a bath
- {風呂上|ふろあ}がり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to drink after a bath
- {風呂上|ふろあ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: skin right after bathing
- {風呂上|ふろあ}がり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ストレッチ→ストレッチ：05239_sutorecchi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to stretch after bathing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{湯上|ゆあ}がり→湯上がり：22239_yuagari⟧: after bathing — essentially the same meaning but uses ⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧ (hot water) instead of ⟦{風呂|ふろ}→風呂：14633_furo⟧; sounds slightly more refined
- {入浴後|にゅうよくご}: after bathing — more formal and clinical, used in medical or skincare instructions

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, {風呂上|ふろあ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧ (a beer right after the bath) and {風呂上|ふろあ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}→牛乳：00777_gyuunyuu⟧ (milk after the bath, especially at public baths) are iconic pleasures of daily life.
